title: Final Energy Shift
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the shift in ground state energy to second order in k.

title: Expectation Value of x
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine that the expectation value of x in the ground state is zero.

title: First Order Correction
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify that the first order energy correction does not contribute due to symmetry.

title: Second Order Correction Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct setup and evaluation of the second order energy correction.

title: Symmetry Argument
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a valid argument based on symmetry for the expectation value of x.

title: Integration Setup
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the correct setup for the integrals involved in the calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the energy correction calculations.
